explanation: Check odd starting values, following each Collatz trajectory until it falls below the start or reaches a previously verified odd value. A per-trajectory set detects cycles; arithmetic overflow is rejected.
timeComplexity: O(n+T) expected, where T is the total number of visited trajectory steps
spaceComplexity: O(U+M), for U cached odd values and M values in the largest trajectory
